company.name: AutoStream
company.description: AutoStream is a SaaS platform that provides automated video editing tools for content creators. Our AI-powered editor handles trimming, transitions, captions, and color grading — so creators can focus on content, not post-production.
company.tagline: Edit smarter. Create faster. Grow bigger.

policies.details: No refunds are issued after 7 days from the date of purchase. Refund requests within the first 7 days will be reviewed case-by-case.
24/7 live support is available exclusively on the Pro Plan. Basic Plan users receive email support with a 48-hour response window.
You may cancel your subscription at any time. Access continues until the end of the billing period.
AutoStream does not currently offer a free trial, but the Basic Plan is available at a low cost to get started.

faqs.question: What platforms do you support?
faqs.answer: AutoStream exports are optimized for YouTube, Instagram Reels, TikTok, and general MP4 format.

faqs.question: Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade at any time. Upgrades take effect immediately; downgrades apply at the next billing cycle.

faqs.question: Is there a limit on video length?
faqs.answer: Basic Plan supports videos up to 30 minutes. Pro Plan supports videos up to 4 hours.

faqs.question: Do you support team accounts?
faqs.answer: Team and agency plans are coming soon. Contact our sales team for early access.
